items.title: Ed Allen Interview, 1961-01-14
items.q: I remember Leroy Smith went to Carter then before Adam Ross

ctx.x: Do you remember when Perron's band came to New York? That was in the one of the band that came up there?

Yeah, but that was before I came to New York. That was before you came up there. Yeah. I remember reading about him. I remember Leroy Smith went to Carter then before Adam Ross, and he went back in there after the Art Tis came out. He went back in there. How about after you left the Cotton Museum? After I left the Cotton Museum, I went to do freelance gigging. I don't know who they were. I never heard the records before. I got paid for them. That's all I was interested. Well Willie the Lion Smith was one of them,…
